legal_dispute_adjudication.name: Complaints

blueprint.name: Complaints
blueprint.description: Manages complaints records and associated child items

roles.name: Super Admin
roles.description: Apex system administration, security configurations, role assignment, and audit logs

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Operational case oversight, staff allocation, reporting dossiers, and institutional analytics

roles.name: Complainant
roles.description: Aggrieved citizen registering grievance petition, submitting documents, and tracking case progress

roles.name: Assistant Registrar
roles.description: Initial petition scrutiny, deficiency notices, diary numbering, and case dossier compilation

roles.name: Registrar
roles.description: Maintainability determination, bench scheduling, summons & notice dispatch to respondents

roles.name: Ombudsperson
roles.description: Federal Ombudsperson presiding over judicial hearings, interim injunctions, and final decrees

roles.name: Advisor
roles.description: Senior judicial advisory, legal research briefs, hearing assistance, and case analysis

roles.name: Law Officer
roles.description: Legal scrutiny, court compliance tracking, judgment implementation enforcement, and contempt review

workflow:
  enabled: true
  state_column: complaint_status_id
  states:
    -
      slug: pending
      label: Pending
      color: amber
    -
      slug: deficient
      label: Deficient
      color: rose
    -
      slug: maintainability
      label: Maintainability
      color: blue
    -
      slug: preliminary_hearing
      label: 'Preliminary Hearing'
      color: purple
    -
      slug: notice_to_respondent
      label: 'Notice to Respondent'
      color: indigo
    -
      slug: reply
      label: Reply
      color: cyan
    -
      slug: regular_hearing
      label: 'Regular Hearing'
      color: teal
    -
      slug: evidence_of_parties
      label: 'Evidence of parties'
      color: blue
    -
      slug: cross_examination
      label: 'Cross Examination'
      color: purple
    -
      slug: reports
      label: 'Reports / For Report'
      color: cyan
    -
      slug: arguments
      label: 'Final Arguments'
      color: teal
    -
      slug: orders
      label: Orders
      color: orange
    -
      slug: final_judgement
      label: 'Final judgement'
      color: emerald
    -
      slug: notice_for_implementation
      label: 'Notice for implementation'
      color: indigo
    -
      slug: order_implemented
      label: 'Order Implemented'
      color: emerald
    -
      slug: contempt
      label: Contempt
      color: rose
    -
      slug: rejected
      label: Rejected
      color: slate
  transitions:
    -
      slug: mark_deficient
      name: 'Mark Deficient'
      from:
        - pending
        - maintainability
      to: deficient
      target_role: assistant_registrar
      requires_remarks: true
    -
      slug: resubmit_petition
      name: 'Resubmit Petition'
      from:
        - deficient
      to: pending
      target_role: complainant
    -
      slug: scrutinize_maintainability
      name: 'Verify Maintainability'
      from:
        - pending
      to: maintainability
      target_role: assistant_registrar
    -
      slug: reject_petition
      name: 'Reject Petition'
      from:
        - maintainability
        - preliminary_hearing
      to: rejected
      target_role: registrar
      requires_remarks: true
    -
      slug: schedule_preliminary
      name: 'Schedule Preliminary Hearing'
      from:
        - maintainability
      to: preliminary_hearing
      target_role: registrar
    -
      slug: issue_notice
      name: 'Issue Notice to Respondent'
      from:
        - maintainability
        - preliminary_hearing
      to: notice_to_respondent
      target_role: registrar
    -
      slug: submit_reply
      name: 'Submit Reply'
      from:
        - notice_to_respondent
      to: reply
      target_role: assistant_registrar
    -
      slug: conduct_regular_hearing
      name: 'Conduct Regular Hearing'
      from:
        - reply
        - preliminary_hearing
      to: regular_hearing
      target_role: ombudsperson
    -
      slug: record_evidence
      name: 'Record Evidence'
      from:
        - regular_hearing
